import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    rows = [
        (1, "t1", "o1", "A", "a", None),
        (2, "t2", "o1", "B", "b", None),   # cross-tenant
        (3, "t1", "o2", "C", "c", None),   # cross-owner
        (4, "t1", "o1", "D", "d", "2024"), # deleted
        (5, "t1", "o1", "E", "e", None),
        (6, "we'ird", "ow'ner", "F", "f", None),
    ]
    c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)", rows)
    c.commit()
    return c

c = fresh()
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"}
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 2) is None
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 3) is None
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 4) is None
assert all(set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in [get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 1)])
assert [d["id"] for d in list_documents(c, "t1", "o1")] == [1, 5]
assert list_documents(c, "t2", "o1") == [{"id": 2, "title": "B", "body": "b"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t1", "o2") == [{"id": 3, "title": "C", "body": "c"}]
assert list_documents(c, "nobody", "no one") == []
assert get_document(c, "we'ird", "ow'ner", 6) == {"id": 6, "title": "F", "body": "f"}
assert [d["id"] for d in list_documents(c, "we'ird", "ow'ner")] == [6]
print("security checks passed")
